Class MetabolicEcologyEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.engine.AbstractSimulationEngine
org.ether.society.engines.tier1.MetabolicEcologyEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
SimulationEngineModule
public class MetabolicEcologyEngine extends AbstractSimulationEngine
Universal Metabolic Theory of Ecology (MTE) Engine.

Formalizes the allometric and kinetic unification established by Brown, Gillooly, Allen, Savage & West (2004, Toward a metabolic theory of ecology, Ecology) and Gillooly et al. (2001, 2002, Science/Nature).

Unifies Kleiber's 3/4 allometric mass-scaling with Boltzmann-Arrhenius biochemical kinetics:

  1. Individual Metabolic Rate: \[ B(M, T) = B_0 \cdot M^{3/4} \cdot \exp\left(-\frac{E_a}{k_B T}\right) \] where \(M\) is body mass in \(\text{kg}\), \(T\) is absolute temperature in Kelvin, \(k_B = 8.617333 \times 10^{-5}\text{ eV/K}\), and \(E_a \approx 0.65\text{ eV}\) is the universal activation energy for respiratory metabolism across all aerobic organisms.
  2. Intrinsic Population Growth Rate: \[ r_{\text{max}}(M, T) = r_0 \cdot M^{-1/4} \cdot \exp\left(-\frac{E_a}{k_B T}\right) \]
  3. Biological Generation Time: \[ t_{\text{gen}}(M, T) = t_0 \cdot M^{1/4} \cdot \exp\left(\frac{E_a}{k_B T}\right) \]

Applicable across both human and non-human taxa (terrestrial mammals, megafauna, livestock, marine fish, plants, and microorganisms) to compute emergent biological rates from conserved physical observables (\(O(1)\) per cell/taxon).
